pcs.pc_description: Use suitable ppe like rubber hand gloves and nose mask as required.
Ensure the place/room is clean, ventilated and well lit.
Take suitable quantity of gypsum/chalk powder and sareesh.
Transfer the mixture to clean bowl.
Mix the ingredients well manually with wooden rod.
Check the solution has developed desired level of viscosity.
A small part of cotton cloth is dipped into the solution.
The object is with the cotton cloth soaked with the solution.
Allow the object to dry for an hour or so.
Second coat is done in the same way and allow the object to dry.
The process is continued till desired level of coating is attained.
Usually after 3rd coat is dried, finishing is started.
The object is rubbed with special stone (kirkut).
Rubbing continues till desired level of smoothness is attained.

modules.module_title: Carry out process activities of making frame

pcs.pc_description: Use suitable ppe like hand glove, nose mask etc. as required.
Cut strips of wood and leave it to dry in open atmosphere.
Cut strips into suitable pieces manually or with the help of mechanical saw mill.
Smoothen the wooden pieces with smoothing plane.
Trim the edges with hand saw.
Join parts of frames with adhesive like fevicol.
Put 4mm thick ply wood board as backing to the frame. ply wood board may be decorated with velvet fabric to enhance look.
Fix the side and arm with nails and hinges as per requirement.
Insert supporting stand at the back.
Place the artifact of desired craft work inside the frame.
Protect the object (craft work) with glass covering cut to size and fixed with nails.
Stabilize the object by fixing with tapes at all sides and edges.
